title: Paddle Game Ready
style: Pop-rap sports anthem with a sharp mid-tempo bounce, tight boom-clap percussion, rubbery bass, and handclap accents; verse rides nimble percussion with quick-fire lines, pre-chorus lifts with rising chants and snapped doubles, chorus hits with gang vocals and a chantable hook. Vocal is confident and close-mic in verses, stacked and shouted on hooks, with short delay throws on the title words. Add ear candy like whistle hits before the chorus, shoe squeaks as transitions, and a short crowd-riser into the final hook. Mix is bright, punchy, and stadium-clean.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Grip tight, eyes locked
Fresh tape on my paddle
Warm-up swings, clean snap
Footwork light as gravel
Practice reps, no nerves
I read the serve, I split fast
You bring heat, I bring calm
Then I send it right back

[Pre-Chorus]
One breath
One beat
Line up
Watch me
No fear
No slack
I’m dialed in
I’m on track

[Chorus]
Paddle game ready
Paddle game ready
I step in steady
Paddle game ready
Paddle game ready
I’m built for the pressure
Paddle game ready
(paddle game ready)

[Verse 2]
Kitchen line, patient hands
Drop shot kissing the tape
Quick roll, cross-court
Make your whole setup shake
Serve deep, chase that bounce
I’m already two steps ahead
Cold stare, hot finish
That’s the way I stay fed

One breath
One beat
Line up
Watch me
No fear
No slack
I’m dialed in
I’m on track

[Chorus]
Paddle game ready

I step in steady
Paddle game ready
Paddle game ready
I’m built for the pressure
Paddle game ready

[Bridge]
Last call, one point
All eyes on my side
Heart calm, legs quick
Nowhere left to hide
I came for the moment
I came for the win
Say it again, say it loud
Let the game begin

[Chorus]

Paddle game ready
(paddle game ready)
